items.title: Forget big tech: the real AI money is in plumbing
items.summary: Host Kenny Polcari joins Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre and Founder ETFs' Michael Monaghan to explore the data showing why founder-led companies significantly outperform the market. The panel also breaks down the flawless execution of the SpaceX IPO, the overlooked opportunities in AI infrastructure, and why the next major productivity boom will mirror the historical shift from steam to electricity.

items.title: Super Micro stock jumps on upbeat outlook
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Josh Lipton on Asking for a Trend to break down Super Micro's (SMCI) latest results and upbeat outlook, as strong demand for AI infrastructure continues to drive the company’s growth.

items.title: Super Micro Stock Is the Best S&P 500 Performer as Earnings Smash Expectations
items.summary: Super Micro reported adjusted earnings of $1.70 per share, compared with the 92 cents per share analysts were expecting.

items.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Dell Technologies, Super Micro Computer, Hewlett Packard and HP
items.summary: Dell Technologies trades at a premium, but soaring AI server demand, record backlog and a broad portfolio could support further growth.

items.title: Super Micro Advances 13%, Dell Gains 5%, HPE Rises 3% on Blowout AI Server Guidance
items.summary: Super Micro Computer just delivered guidance that sent shockwaves through the entire AI server sector, but analysts are refusing to celebrate without answers to one stubborn question about margins.

items.title: Apple Stock's Biggest Risk Is The Memory Bill, Not Demand
items.summary: Record demand is not the danger for Apple stock; the danger is a component bill that keeps climbing and has already begun to take margin down.

items.title: Dell, HPE gain pre-market as SMCI posts blowout revenue guidance
items.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE: HPE) are rising in sympathy ahead of the open, as investors treat SMCI’s results as a live demand barometer for the entire AI server hardware sector. When SMCI previously reported disappointing results, Dell shares fell in tandem — and the reverse dynamic is now playing out. DELL is up 2.6%, while HPE is up 2.2%.

items.title: Bechtle Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Bechtle (ETR:BC8) reported double-digit growth across most key metrics in the second quarter and first half of 2026, prompting the IT services provider to raise its full-year outlook despite what management described as continued challenging market conditions.
